name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人ゴジータ
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Gogeta

description.ja: 映画『ドラゴンボール超 ブロリー』で、ブロリーと壮絶な戦いを繰り広げる「超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人ゴジータ」がFigure-rise Standardに登場！
description.en: "Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Gogeta " who fights a fierce battle with Broly in the movie " Dragon Ball Super: Broly" is now available in Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: 悟空とベジータがフュージョンした超戦士を組み立てろ！
description.en: Assemble the fused super warrior of Goku and Vegeta!

description.ja: • マッスルビルドシステムによる、超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人ゴジータの強靭な肉体を再現！
description.en: • Reproduce the strong body of Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Gogeta using the Muscle Build System!

description.ja: • 特徴的な衣装は、新規造形で再現。
description.en: • Characteristic costumes are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: • Figure-rise Standardシリーズ最多の4種の必殺技エフェクトが付属。
description.en: • Comes with 4 types of special move effects, the most in the Figure-rise Standard series.

description.ja: • 黒髪状態も再現できる頭部パーツが付属！
description.en: • Head parts are included to recreate black hair!

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト4種（かめはめ波〈溜め〉、かめはめ波〈放出〉、ビッグ・バン・アタック、ファイナルフラッシュ）×各1
accessories.en: 4 types of special move effects (Kamehameha (charge), Kamehameha (release), Big Bang Attack, Final Flash) x 1 each

accessories.ja: 青髪表情パーツ2種（平常、叫び）×各1
accessories.en: 2 types of blue hair expression parts (normal, screaming) x 1 each

accessories.ja: 黒髪表情パーツ2種（平常、叫び）×各1
accessories.en: 2 types of black hair expression parts (normal, screaming) x 1 each

accessories.ja: 手首パーツ4種（左右握り手、左右かめはめ波手）×各1
accessories.en: 4 types of wrist parts (left and right grip hands, left and right kamehame wave hands) x 1 each
